definitions.explanation: The third sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly May 21 to June 21. Also the constellation Gemini. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{双子座|ふたござ}です。
{双子座|ふたござ}と{天秤座|てんびんざ}は{相性|あいしょう}がいいらしい。
examples.english: Gemini and Libra are apparently compatible.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}の{番組|ばんぐみ}で、{今日|きょう}の{双子座|ふたござ}は{一位|いちい}だと{紹介|しょうかい}された。
examples.english: On the morning show, Gemini was introduced as today's number-one sign.

notes:
The zodiac sign Gemini, for people born from late May to late June.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {双子座|ふたござ}の{人|ひと}: a person born under Gemini
- {双子座|ふたござ}{生|う}まれ: born a Gemini
- {双子座|ふたござ}の{運勢|うんせい}: the Gemini horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments ({星占|ほしうらな}い).
